answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a copper-denominated refundable stake bond before it can earn, with each signed claim recorded like a quill entry in a public mirror ledger any peer can audit. Honest work that survives peer attestation refunds the bond, so joining is cheap for one real agent. A Sybil attacker must lock a fresh bond per fake identity and forfeits each one peers catch, so the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes while the reward per fake stays capped — forgery becomes a losing trade.
